# N2 IETM paper v10 — coupled cryptographic mutation and shared dispatch

Status: **PAPER RED / ZERO CREDIT / TWO FRESH STATIC REVIEWS REQUIRED**

N2-v10 freezes v9 unchanged and retains only its authentic topology. C19 is coupled through derived-root resealing into real signature failure; leaf identities derive from validator byte spans; production and audit share one dispatch; suppression, sentinel control-of-control, refusal, and all 1,806 nonowner rows are separate materialized source paths; and a 172-row static route matrix binds every variant to one intended invariant.

All proposed source remains materialized and unexecuted. Every result is planned, never observed.
